headline: The Geometry of Truth's linear truth direction survives across 2024-2025 models and families: MM cross-dataset generalization (larger+smaller -> sp_en_trans) is 0.986 on Llama-3.1-8B, 0.977 on Qwen3-8B-Base, 0.960 on Qwen2.5-7B and 0.935 on OLMo-3-7B, vs 0.9746 on the 2023 Llama-2-13B anchor.

Qwen2.5-7B flip-rate vs intervention magnitude (causal direction is aligned, just under-powered at 1x)

figures.caption: C3 cross-dataset generalization (larger+smaller -> sp_en_trans) by model release era. MM (mass-mean) is the primary series; LR/CCS secondary. Dashed line = replicated Llama-2-13B anchor (0.9746). Every 2024-2025 base model stays at 0.93-0.99; Qwen2.5-7B->Instruct pair connected in pink.
figures.alt: Scatter of generalization accuracy vs release year; all modern models near 0.95-0.99, above the 2023 7B and near the 13B anchor line.

figures.caption: Top-2 PCA of cities activations colored by truth label (C1), one panel per model at its best layer. True/false separate cleanly in all families. OLMo-3-7B shows a single massive-activation outlier (family-specific) but still separates by label.
figures.alt: Six PCA scatter panels; blue true and orange false points form separated clusters in each.

figures.caption: Mean out-of-distribution generalization (MM off-diagonal, C19) vs parameters, colored by family. All 2024-2025 ~7-8B models (0.73-0.85) sit well above Llama-2-7B (0.52) and at/above the 13B anchor (0.77) - era matters more than raw scale.
figures.alt: Log-x scatter of mean OOD accuracy vs params; modern small models cluster high, 2023 7B low.

notes: Anchor baselines read from disk and reproduced exactly by the followup pipeline (13B MM 0.9746, 7B MM 0.9266).
All five new architectures loaded from local snapshots on the first try; no fallback swaps needed. Pinned: transformers 4.57.1, nnsight 0.4.11, torch 2.14.0+cu130, Python 3.11.15.
Extraction bounded as specified: N<=1000/dataset (seed 0), 8 datasets, ~6 sweep layers, bf16; realized 1.6 GB (cap 20 GB) and ~0.4 GPU-h on one A40 (cap 8).

Flip-rate is a cheap single-MM-direction analog of C2/C17, not the 12-cell NIE table; the ~0 flips for Qwen/OLMo at natural magnitude are readout saturation, not causal failure (4x recovers 0.49 on Qwen2.5-7B).
70B logprobs (C4/C5) and full patching sweeps (C6/C7/C16) not extended per instruction; kept on the two Llama-2 anchors already on disk.
